en.hubeali: And in another Hadeeth, he said, ‘I said, ‘What is the limit of the humbleness which, when the servant does it, he would be (considered as) humble?’

So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘The humbleness has levels – from it is that you recognise the person in accordance with himself, so he would lodge him at his status with a peaceful heart, not loving going to anyone except with similar to what he loves to be brought to him.
If he sees a sin, he shields it with the good deed, swallowing the anger, pardoning the people. And Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Loves the good doers’.
